$comment: Generated by tools/export_system.py from the scripts and the stylesheet — do not edit. The names that exist only at run time, for a build step that cuts the stylesheet to what the pages use (README, section „Cut the stylesheet to what the pages use“). `scripts`: for each script of this file's part of the copy, what the script can set, add, toggle or query and the stylesheet of the profile (css/sebaro.css with every pack, and tokens.css) has a selector or a declaration for. `classes` and `attributes`: every word of the script's string literals that is a class or an attribute name of a selector; every class or attribute that begins with a fragment a literal ends in ("sb-status--" + kind); the attribute of a `dataset` member (dataset.sbTone: data-sb-tone) and of an assigned DOM property (el.hidden = …: hidden). `asked`: the classes the script only looks for and never sets: every literal that names one is handed straight to querySelector, querySelectorAll, closest, matches, classList.contains or getElementsByClassName. Such a class is on a page or it is not, so a cut needs no list of it; a class named anywhere else in the script is in `classes`. `tags`: the elements the script creates (createElement, markup in a literal) that a selector names. `properties`: the custom properties a literal names or begins. `icons`: the symbols of icons/sprite.svg a literal names or begins. Comments of the script are not read. `states`: of the rules of this file's part of the stylesheet, the state classes (is-…) and the ARIA attributes (aria-…) their selectors name: state that a script or the product's own code sets and no authored page needs to show. A copy holds css/runtime-names.json for its core and css/runtime-names.<pack>.json for each of its packs with a script or rules.
